about.title: Building functional, well-structured software solutions that make a real impact.
about.p1: I am a Software Engineer and Mobile Developer with a focus on building Android applications and full-stack web solutions. During my Information Systems studies, I graduated as the Best Graduate with a 3.95 GPA, which gave me a strong foundation in understanding software engineering deeply.
about.p2: My professional journey expanded after graduating from the Bangkit Academy program (led by Google, GoTo, and Traveloka) in the Mobile Development learning path with a Distinction predicate. Currently, I am highly interested in implementing Clean Architecture, optimizing system performance, and exploring how artificial intelligence, like Google Gemini, can be integrated into applications to solve everyday problems.
about.p3: For me, writing code is not just about making an application run, but also about discipline, proactive problem-solving, and maintaining high quality standards. I apply this mindset whether I am architecting native Android apps with Kotlin and MVVM or building efficient web systems.

experience.title: Work Experience
experience.subtitle: My career journey in managing IT infrastructure, teaching programming, and developing systems.

items.description: Currently, I am responsible for providing technical support for IT infrastructure, assisting with statistical data processing, and compiling comprehensive system documentation. My goal is to ensure smooth operations and workflows within the regional statistical office.

While teaching, I mentored over 20 students in understanding programming logic, algorithms, and software development fundamentals. I am proud to have achieved a 93% student and parent satisfaction rate through a structured and engaging learning approach.

I managed the university's computer laboratory infrastructure, ensuring zero downtime during practical sessions. Additionally, I assisted lecturers with system configurations and supervised technical examinations.

projects.title: Selected Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of my software engineering projects, ranging from AI integrations and native Android apps to web-based document automation systems.

items.title: BAST V2
items.description: A web platform designed to automate the creation of official handover documents (BAST). This system processes data from Excel spreadsheets and dynamically generates officially formatted Word documents, significantly saving time on manual drafting.

items.title: Double A Calorie (A2Bot)
items.description: A smart WhatsApp bot that I integrated with Google Gemini 1.5. Users can simply send a photo or description of their food, and the bot will analyze the nutritional content, estimate calories, and provide dietary advice in real-time.

items.title: Virtual Class App
items.description: A native Android application I developed using Kotlin, Clean Architecture (MVVM), and Room database. It is built to be robust, featuring real-time attendance verification, course material distribution, and offline data synchronization capabilities.

items.title: Valorant Agent Explorer
items.description: An exploration app for Valorant agents, abilities, and weapons. I designed it using Clean Architecture, a multi-module structure, automated CI/CD integration with GitHub Actions, and a responsive user interface layout.

education.title: Education & Honors

degrees.description: Completed my studies and achieved the title of best graduate at the faculty level. During my university years, I focused heavily on software engineering, database design, and enterprise information systems development.

Graduated with a Distinction predicate in this intensive mobile engineering program. Here, I deeply studied advanced Android development, Clean Architecture implementation, Kotlin coroutines, and Google Cloud integrations.
